blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hallucinated information can propagate through multi-stage LLM systems and become part of the context for subsequent reasoning. Existing studies of post-hallucination reasoning (PHR) mainly characterize changes in final outcomes and aggregate reasoning dynamics, leaving how models resolve hallucinated premises at the response level insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce PHRBench , a controlled benchmark for behaviorally structured PHR across four domains and 18 18 large language models. PHRBench characterizes each reasoning trajectory independently of final-answer correctness through Hallucination Compliance , Hallucination Avoidance , and Heuristic Correction , and defines an insightful trajectory as successful correction that ultimately reaches the correct answer. Across 4820 4820 controlled instances, we find that successful recovery remains relatively rare and is associated with more frequent belief updates along the reasoning trajectory. We further find that properties of the hallucinated prompt contain substantial predictive signal for successful recovery, with a lightweight predictor achieving an AUROC of 0.847 0.847 . These findings provide a behavioral view of post-hallucination reasoning, characterizing how LLMs resolve erroneous context and when successful recovery is likely to occur. Code: github.com/menglinghao2025/PHR Dataset: huggingface.co/datasets/menglinghao2025/PHR Homepage: menglinghao2025.github.io/PHR
blocks.zh: 幻觉信息可以通过多相LLM系统来传播,并成为后续推理的背景的一部分. 现有对卤化后推理的研究主要描述最终结果和综合推理动态的变化,使得模型在反应层面如何解决幻觉假设缺乏足够的理解. 在这部作品中,我们引入了PHR Bench,这是行为结构的受控基准,涉及四个领域和18个大语言模型. PHR Bench将每个推理轨迹与最终答案的正确性分开,通过"幻觉遵守","幻觉避免","Heuristic Record"来描述,并将有洞察力的轨迹定义为成功校正,最终达到正确的答案. 在4820起4820起受控事件中,我们发现成功的恢复仍然相对罕见,而且与沿推理轨迹更频繁地更新信仰有关。 我们进一步发现,幻觉快感的特性含有大量成功恢复的预测信号,轻量级预测器的AUROC为0.847 0.847。 这些结论提供了对吸入后推理的行为观点,描述LLMS如何解决错误上下文以及何时可能成功恢复. 代码:github.com/menlinghao2025/PHR 数据集:拥抱面.co/dataset/menlinghao2025/PHR 主页:manglinghao2025.github.io/PHR

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Despite substantial progress in detection and mitigation methods, large language models continue to produce hallucinations across diverse tasks and settings ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Farquhar et al., 2024 ; Li, 2025 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Kalai et al., 2025 ; Janiak et al., 2025 ; Tamber et al., 2025 ; Ganesh et al., 2026 ) . Existing safeguards can reduce such errors, but cannot reliably prevent every hallucinated statement from entering subsequent processing ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Kalai et al., 2025 ; Janiak et al., 2025 ) . This limitation becomes increasingly consequential as LLM outputs are reused across retrieval systems, tool-augmented pipelines, autonomous agents, and multi-stage generation workflows ( Niu et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) . In these systems, an output produced at one stage often becomes the context for subsequent reasoning. As illustrated in Figure 1 (a), hallucinated information that escapes upstream detection can therefore propagate through the system and act as a premise for downstream decisions ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Jamshidi, 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) . System reliability consequently depends not only on preventing hallucinations, but also on whether downstream models can recover once hallucinated information is already present. HIVE ( He et al., 2026 ) introduces post-hallucination reasoning (PHR) to study this downstream reliability problem and shows that hallucination can persistently reshape subsequent reasoning.
blocks.zh: 尽管在探测和缓解方法方面取得了很大进展,但大型语言模型仍然在不同的任务和环境中产生幻觉(张等,2025;法克哈尔等,2024;李等,2025;吴等,2023;卡来等,2025;贾尼亚克等,2025;谭伯等,2025;甘内什等,2026)。 现有的保障措施可以减少这种错误,但不能可靠地防止每个幻觉声明进入后续处理(徐等,2024;Kalai等,2025;Janiak等,2025.). 由于LLM的输出在检索系统、工具增强管、自主剂和多阶段生成工作流程中重复使用,这种限制变得日益严重(Niu等,2024;Yao等,2022;Wu等,2023)。 在这些系统中,一个阶段产生的产出往往成为以后推理的背景。 如图1 (a)所显示的,逃避上游检测的幻觉信息可通过系统传播,并成为下游决策的前提(张等,2023;钟等,2024;Jamshidi,2026;Cui等,2026;Hu等,2025)。 因此,系统可靠性不仅取决于预防幻觉,还取决于下游模型在已经存在幻觉信息后是否能够恢复. HIVE(He等,2026年)引入了后卤素推理(PHR)来研究这一下游可靠性问题,并表明幻觉可以持续地重塑后继推理.

blocks.en:
HIVE ( He et al., 2026 ) further reveals that hallucinated context can either impair or improve downstream performance, indicating that its effects cannot be explained by factuality alone. However, existing PHR analysis mainly characterizes changes in final outcomes and aggregate reasoning dynamics, without systematically distinguishing response-level behaviors toward hallucinated premises ( Ganesh et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2024a ; Grover et al., 2024 ; Zhan et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) . As previewed in Figure 1 (b), the same correct answer may arise from fundamentally different behaviors.
A model may accept the hallucinated semantics yet still arrive at the correct answer, bypass the premise without resolving it, or explicitly identify and correct the underlying error. Conversely, a model may identify and correct a hallucinated premise but still fail to derive the correct answer.
Final correctness therefore conflates compliance, avoidance, successful correction, and correction failure. Aggregate trajectory statistics provide additional evidence about how reasoning changes, but they still do not identify the resolution behavior taken by an individual response.
Without distinguishing resolution behavior from final outcome , a correct answer may be mistaken for successful hallucination resolution.
blocks.zh:
HIVE(他等,2026年)还进一步揭示出幻觉背景可能损害或改善下游的性能,表明其影响不能仅由事实来解释. 然而,现有的PHR分析主要描述最终结果的变化和综合推理动态,而没有系统地区分对幻觉假设的反应层次行为(Ganesh等,2026;Lee等,2024a;Grover等,2024;Zhan等,2026;Lu等,2026b.). 如图1 (b)所预览,同样正确的答案可能来自根本不同的行为.
模型可能接受幻觉的语义,然而仍然得出正确的答案,绕过前提而不解决,或者明确识别并纠正背后的错误. 反之,一个模型可能识别和纠正一个幻觉的前提,但仍然无法得出正确的答案.
因此,最后正确性概括了遵约、回避、成功纠正和纠正失败。 综合道轨迹统计为推理变化提供了更多证据,但它们仍然无法识别单个响应所做出的解析行为.
不区分解析行为与最终结果,正确的答案可能误认为是成功的幻觉解析.

blocks.en: In this paper, we study PHR as a behaviorally structured resolution process through PHRBench , a controlled benchmark of 4820 4820 instances spanning Chemistry, Biomedicine, Physics, and Code Generation. We evaluate 18 18 proprietary and open-source models and characterize each reasoning trajectory independently of final-answer correctness as Hallucination Compliance , Hallucination Avoidance , or Heuristic Correction . We further define an insightful trajectory as one that performs Heuristic Correction and reaches the correct answer. Using this framework, we ask two questions. Q1: How do LLMs resolve hallucinated premises, and how does successful recovery vary with model scale and reasoning dynamics? We analyze behavioral resolution and trajectory dynamics across models and scales. Q2: Can successful recovery be predicted before response generation? We evaluate the predictive signal of prompt-level structural and semantic features.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们通过PHR Bench将PHR作为一种行为结构化的解析过程来研究,这个控制基准包括化学,生物医学,物理和代码生成等4820个案例. 我们评价了18个专有和开源模型, 将每个推理轨迹 独立于最后的正确性, 我们进一步将具有洞察力的轨迹定义为执行高uristic修正并找到正确答案的轨迹。 我们利用这一框架提出了两个问题。 问题1:LLMS如何解决幻觉所处地,成功恢复如何随模型尺度和推理动态而变化? 我们分析不同模型和尺度的行为分辨率和轨迹动态。 问题2:能否在生成反应之前预测成功恢复? 我们评价了即时水平结构和语义特征的预测信号。

blocks.en: Our results, summarized in Figure 1 (c), reveal three main findings. First, scaling creates a tension between contextual vulnerability and corrective capability: hallucinated context reduces accuracy by 7.7 7.7 percentage points on average, with larger degradation at greater scales within multiple model families, while corrective behavior becomes more frequent. Second, successful recovery remains rare and exhibits a distinct reasoning signature. Insightful trajectories are associated with more frequent belief updates, suggesting more effective revision after conflicts are detected. Third, successful recovery contains substantial ex ante predictive signal. Prompt-level features achieve an AUROC of 0.847 0.847 , with both structural and semantic factors contributing to prediction.
blocks.zh: 图1(c)概述了我们的成果,其中揭示出三个主要调查结果。 第一,缩放在上下文脆弱性和矫正能力之间造成紧张:幻觉上下文平均将精度降低7.7个百分点,在多模式家庭内部,退化程度更大,而矫正行为更频繁. 第二,成功的追回仍然很少见,并显示出明显的推理特征。 透视轨迹与更频繁的信仰更新有关,建议在发现冲突后进行更有效的修订. 第三,成功恢复包含大量的事先预测信号。 即时级特征的AUROC为0.847 0.847,结构因素和语义因素都有助于预测。

blocks.en:
Figure 1: Overview of behaviorally structured post-hallucination reasoning. (a) Hallucinations that escape upstream detection can propagate into downstream reasoning, making recovery critical for reliable LLM systems.
(b) Final correctness alone cannot reveal how a model handles hallucinated context.
(c) PHRBench reveals a scaling tension between vulnerability and correction, characterizes and predicts successful correction before generation.
blocks.zh:
图 1: 行为结构化后卤素推理概述. (a) 逃避上游探测的幻觉可以传播到下游推理中,使恢复对可靠的低低分辨率系统至关重要。
(b) 仅凭最后正确性无法揭示模型如何处理幻觉背景。
(c) PHR Bench揭示出脆弱性与矫正之间的规模紧张,在生成之前描述和预测成功的矫正。

blocks.en: Our key contributions are as follows: ❶We introduce PHRBench for behaviorally structured post-hallucination reasoning. Across 4 4 domains and 18 18 LLMs, PHRBench contains 4820 4820 controlled instances and separates behavioral resolution from final-answer correctness through compliance, avoidance, and correction. ❷We reveal a scaling tension and characterize successful recovery. Model scaling reveals a tension between robustness to hallucinated context and corrective capability, while successful recovery exhibits a distinct pattern of reasoning revision. ❸We show that successful recovery contains substantial ex ante predictive signal. Using lightweight structural and semantic features, we show that successful recovery can be anticipated before generation, providing a foundation for intervention mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们介绍PHR Bench 用于行为结构化的后吸血推理. PHR Bench在4个领域和18个LLMs中包含4820个4820个受控实例,并通过遵守、避免和纠正将行为分辨率与最后回答正确性区分开来。 我们揭示了一种规模化的紧张局势,并成为成功复苏的特征。 模型的缩放揭示出对幻觉背景的稳健性和矫正能力之间的紧张关系,而成功的恢复则显示出一种独特的推理修正模式。 我们显示,成功恢复包含大量的事先预测信号。 我们利用轻量级的结构和语义特征,表明在世代相传之前可以预期成功的恢复,为干预机制提供基础.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Prior work on post-hallucination reasoning has examined how hallucinated information is transmitted across subsequent generations and interactions ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Gan et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
MMHalSnowball ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) shows that earlier hallucinations can mislead later responses even when visual evidence remains available.
MM-Snowball ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) examines how hallucinated information accumulates as models increasingly rely on contaminated conversational history.
The Woozle Effect ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) investigates how hallucinated information is transmitted across agents and influences participants.
Hallucination Cascade ( Jamshidi et al., 2026 ) and Collective Hallucination ( Jamshidi, 2026 ) further analyze how hallucinated content evolves through sequential agent interactions.
Together, these studies trace where hallucinated information propagates across downstream multi reasoning processes.
blocks.zh:
先前关于后卤素推理的工作研究过幻觉信息如何传递到后世和相互作用(Chen等,2024;Gan等,2025;Xiong等,2026;Zhang等,2023;Zhang等,2026;Jiang等,2026).
MMHalSnowball 超级雪球 (Zhong等,2024年)表明,即使视觉证据依然存在,更早的幻觉也能误导后期反应.
MM-Snowball(Jiang等,2026年)研究了随着模型越来越依赖被污染的对话历史,幻觉信息是如何积累的.

blocks.en:
Beyond transmission, another line of work examines how hallucinated outputs are processed in subsequent reasoning ( Lu et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2026a ; Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ; Tyen et al., 2024 ) .
Volcano ( Lee et al., 2024b ) uses self-feedback to revise initial hallucinated responses, while Pelican ( Sahu et al., 2024 ) decomposes generated claims and verifies them through program-of-thought reasoning.
A 2 R ( Lee et al., 2024a ) uses explicit hallucination assessment to guide iterative refinement. DoT ( Grover et al., 2024 ) navigates hallucinated thoughts to improve subsequent reasoning.
SHD ( Lu et al., 2026b ) models hallucination in long CoT as an evolving state across reasoning steps, while DeepHalluBench ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) audits intermediate hallucinations throughout full research trajectories rather than only on final outputs.
These studies characterize PHR through verification, revision, and trajectory-level analysis, but do not distinguish the response-level behaviors through which a model resolves hallucinated content.
blocks.zh:
除了传播之外,另一行工作还研究了在随后的推理中如何处理幻觉输出(Lu等人,2026b;Lu等人,2026a;Dhuliawala等人,2024;Tyen等人,2024).
火山(Lee等,2024b)使用自食自果来修正最初的幻觉反应,而Pelican(Sahu等,2024)则分解所生成的诉求,并通过程序思考来验证.
一种2R(Lee等,2024a.)使用明确的幻觉评估来指导迭代的完善. DoT (Grover等, 2024) 导航出幻觉的思想来改进后来推理.
SHD(Lu等,2026b)在长COT中作为跨推理步骤的演化状态来模拟幻觉;而DeepHallu Bench(Zhan等,2026年)则在整个研究轨迹全程中审计中间幻觉,而不仅仅是最终产出.
这些研究通过核实,修订和轨迹级分析来描述PHR的特点,但并不区分一个模型通过何种反应级行为解决幻觉内容.

blocks.en:
HIVE formalizes the broader setting of post-hallucination reasoning, showing that hallucinated semantics can alter downstream outcomes and reasoning dynamics ( He et al., 2026 ) .
However, these analyses do not reveal how an individual response resolves the hallucinated content it encounters.
Simultaneously, different resolution behaviors can lead to the same final outcome.
Our work therefore studies PHR as a behaviorally structured resolution process, separating response-level resolution behavior from final-answer correctness.
blocks.zh:
HIVE将卤化后推理的更广义的设定正规化,表明幻觉语义可以改变下游的结果和推理动态(He等,2026年).
然而,这些分析并未揭示个人反应如何解决其遇到的幻觉内容。
同时,不同的分辨率行为可以导致相同的最终结果.
因此,我们的工作把PHR作为一个行为结构化的解析过程来研究,将反应级解析行为与最终答案正确性区分开来.

blocks.en: 3 PHRBench
blocks.zh: 3 PHR 奔驰

blocks.en:
In this section, we introduce PHRBench , a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate post-hallucination reasoning in LLMs. PHRBench is constructed by first collecting diverse reasoning questions across multiple domains and task formats, and then augmenting them with controlled truthful and hallucinated semantic contexts.
This construction enables us to examine not only whether hallucination changes the final answer, but also how it alters the reasoning trajectory.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们介绍了PHR Bench, 该基准旨在系统评价LLMs中的吸入后推理。 PHR Bench的构建首先收集跨越多个领域和任务格式的不同推理问题,再用受控的真实和有幻觉的语义背景来补充.
这种构思使我们能够不仅检查幻觉是否改变最后的答案,而且检查它如何改变推理轨迹。

blocks.en: Overall, PHRBench has three key characteristics:
blocks.zh: 总体而言,PHR Bench有三个关键特征:

blocks.en:
✤ Diverse Reasoning Scenarios. PHRBench ensures diversity along two dimensions.
(1) Multiple Domains : PHRBench contains 460 460 base questions spanning Chemistry, Biomedicine, Physics, and Code Generation, covering heterogeneous domain knowledge.
(2) Multiple Tasks : PHRBench includes both multiple-choice and open-ended questions, allowing us to examine PHR under both constrained answer spaces and free-form generation settings.
The questions are curated from established benchmarks with varying levels of task complexity, providing broad reasoning scenarios.
blocks.zh:
· 各种原因设想。 PHR Bench确保两个层面的多样性。
(1) 多个领域:PHR Bench包含460个基础问题,涉及化学、生物医学、物理和密码生成,涉及不同的领域知识。
(2) 多重任务:PHR Bench既包括多选择问题,也包括开放式问题,使我们能够在有限的解答空间和自由形式的生成设置下审查PHR。
这些问题是从任务复杂程度不同的既定基准中归纳出来的,提供了广泛的推理设想。

blocks.en:
✤ Controlled Semantic Augmentation. PHRBench constructs controlled semantic contexts for each base question to isolate the effect of hallucination on reasoning.
(1) Truthful and Hallucinated Contexts : each question is paired with one truthful and multiple hallucinated augmentations, all preserving task relevance and avoiding answer leakage for controlled comparison.
(2) Multiple Augmentation Patterns : hallucinated augmentations cover three forms of semantic corruption: Rule Contradiction , State Distortion , and Pseudoscientific Entanglement , corresponding to domain principle violations, misreported task-relevant conditions, and outdated scientific theories.
blocks.zh:
控制语义增强。 PHR Bench为每个基础问题构建了受控语义上下文来隔离幻觉对推理的影响.
(1) 真实和令人幻觉的背景:每个问题都与一个真实和多起幻觉的增强组合在一起,所有这些都保持任务的相关性并避免为有控制的比较而回答漏洞。
(2)多增强模式:幻觉增强涵盖三种语义腐败形式:规则矛盾(Rule Contraction),国家扭曲(State Distory),和Pseudosciental Entronglement(Pseudoscientific Entroundment),对应域原则违反,错误报告的任务相关条件,过时的科学理论.

blocks.en:
✤ Reasoning-Oriented Evaluation. PHRBench evaluates PHR from both outcome and reasoning-process perspectives.
For outcome performance, we use Accuracy (Acc) to quantify whether hallucinated context changes the final answer.
For reasoning trajectories, we introduce four diagnostic metrics: Output Length (OL) , Uncertainty Index (UI) , Belief Update Frequency (BUF) , and Branching Complexity (BC) .
This analytical framework enables a fine-grained diagnosis of how hallucinated semantics affect both the final answer and the reasoning process leading to it. Detailed definitions of these metrics are provided in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh:
* 理性导向评价。 PHR Bench从结果和推理过程的角度评价PHR.
对于结果性能,我们使用准确性(Acc)来量化幻觉上下文是否改变最终答案.
关于推理轨迹,我们引入了四个诊断指标:产出长度(OL),不确定性指数(UI),信仰更新频率(BUF)和分支复杂度(BC).
这个分析框架能够对幻觉语义学如何影响最终答案和导致最终答案的推理过程进行精细的诊断. 这些指标的详细定义载于第4.2.节。

blocks.en: Selecting tasks that meaningfully expose PHR is crucial for constructing PHRBench . We therefore focus on scientific reasoning tasks that require models to combine domain knowledge, task-specific conditions, and intermediate inference to derive verifiable outcomes. We consider four domains: Chemistry, Biomedicine, Physics, and Code Generation. The first three emphasize reasoning over scientific knowledge and established principles, while Code Generation extends this setting to computational reasoning.
blocks.zh: 选择有意义地揭露医生促进人权方案的任务对于建造医生促进人权方案本克至关重要。 因此,我们侧重于科学推理任务,这些任务需要模型将域知识、任务特定条件和中间推论结合起来,以得出可核查的结果。 我们考虑四个领域:化学、生物医学、物理和密码生成。 前三篇强调推理优于科学知识和既定原则,而"代码生成"则将这种设定延伸至计算推理.

blocks.en: Following this design, we collect 460 460 base questions from eight established benchmarks across the four domains. The scientific questions are drawn from MoleculeNet-BBBP ( Wu et al., 2018 ) , ChemBench ( Mirza et al., 2025 ) , MedMCQA ( Pal et al., 2022 ) , MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2020 ) , SciQ ( Welbl et al., 2017 ) , and GPQA ( Rein et al., 2023 ) , while coding problems are sourced from HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) , covering both multiple-choice and open-ended reasoning formats. Figure 2 illustrates the distribution of reasoning subtypes and the domain-wise composition of the hallucinated augmentations across three construction types. Detailed source statistics and sampling procedures are provided in Appendix A.1 .

blocks.en: Before augmentation, we standardize the collected questions using task-specific templates that preserve the original task semantics and evaluation criteria. For each standardized base question, we construct one truthful augmentation and multiple hallucinated augmentations without revealing the answer. The truthful version remains factually valid, while each hallucinated version introduces a single targeted semantic mutation with the remaining context preserved. The resulting PHRBench contains 460 460 base questions, 460 460 truthful augmentations, and 3900 3900 hallucinated augmentations, yielding 4820 4820 instances in total. Details of templates, quality control, and representative examples are provided in Appendix A.2 and Appendix A.3 .

blocks.en: Following the evaluation protocol described in Section 4 , we evaluate all 18 models under both the truthful augmentation and hallucinated augmentation settings, denoted as T and H in Table 1 . Comprehensive results are provided in Appendix C .

blocks.en:
Hallucinated context consistently reduces final-answer accuracy across all models, with the degradation becoming more pronounced for stronger and larger models.
As shown in Table 1 , the average accuracy drop is 7.7 % 7.7\% , with GPT-5.2 showing the largest decrease ( 16.9 % ↓ 16.9\%\downarrow ), followed by Gemini-2.5-Pro ( 12.1 % ↓ 12.1\%\downarrow ) and Gemini-2.0-Flash ( 11.1 % ↓ 11.1\%\downarrow ).
Proprietary models also exhibit larger degradation on average than open-source models ( 11.0 % 11.0\% vs. 6.1 % 6.1\% ).
More importantly, degradation consistently increases with model scale.
For example, scaling Qwen2.5 from 1.5 1.5 B to 72 72 B improves baseline accuracy by 27.6 % ↑ 27.6\%\uparrow , while the degradation under hallucinated context doubles to 8.0 % 8.0\% .
Figure 3 further reveals substantial heterogeneity across tasks and augmentation types.
Chemistry shows the lowest average retention across the models, while Physics is comparatively more robust.
Across augmentation types, State Distortion causes the strongest degradation, whereas Pseudoscientific Entanglement retains approximately 98 % 98\% of baseline accuracy.
Thus, susceptibility to hallucinated context also depends on how the hallucinated information conflicts with the task.
blocks.zh:
幻觉上下文持续地降低所有模型的最终答案的准确性,对于更强大和更大的模型来说,退化越来越明显.
如表1所示,平均精度下降为7.7%-7.7%-%,其中GPT-5.2的下降幅度最大(16.9%-16.9-%-下降),其次是双子座-2.5-Pro(12.1%-%-12.1%-下降)和双子座-2.0-Flash(11.1%-11.1%-%-下降)。
专有模型的平均降解率也比开源模型更大(11.0% 11.0\%对6.1% 6.1% 6.1\%)。
更重要的是,退化随着模型规模的扩大而持续增加。
例如,将Quen2.5从1.5 B 缩放到72 72 B,使基线精度提高了27.6% QQ 27.6 oparrow,而幻觉背景下的降解率则翻了一番,达到8.0% 8.0 % .
图3还显示,任务和扩增类型之间差异很大。
化学显示各模型的平均留存率最低,而物理则相对更坚固.
在各种增强类型中,国家扭曲造成最强的退化,而Pseudoscientific Entanglement则保留了大约98%的基线精确度。
因此,对幻觉背景的易感性也取决于幻觉信息如何与任务相冲突.

blocks.en:
Larger models consistently exhibit larger OL , BUF , and BC .
As shown in Table 1 , this scaling pattern holds across the Qwen2.5 , Qwen3 , and Llama-3.1 families under both settings.
For example, scaling Qwen2.5 from 1.5 1.5 B to 72 72 B yields substantial increases in OL of 161.3 161.3 under T and 145.7 145.7 under H. BUF rises by 0.323 0.323 and 0.409 0.409 , while BC grows by 1.439 1.439 and 1.402 1.402 , respectively.
Across models, OL , BUF , and BC also strongly co-vary, with Pearson correlations of 0.908 0.908 , 0.977 0.977 , and 0.856 0.856 , whereas UI shows no consistent scaling pattern.
These results indicate that scaling primarily amplifies the extent and complexity of reasoning, while uncertainty follows a comparatively distinct pattern.

如表1所示,在两种情况下,这种缩放模式贯穿于Quen2.5、Quen3和Llama-3.1家庭。
例如,将Quen2.5从1.5 B 缩放到72 72 B,在T 161.3 161.3和H. BUF 145.7 161.3和155.7 161.3的OL值大幅上升,分别增加了0.323 0.323和0.409 0409;而BC 则分别增加了1.439 1.439和1.402 1.402。
在整个模型中,OL、BUF和BC也具有很强的共活性,皮尔逊的相对比值为:0.908 0.908、0.977 0.977和0.856 0.856,而UI则没有显示一致的缩放模式。
这些结果表明,规模化主要能扩大推理的范围和复杂性,而不确定性则遵循相对不同的模式.

blocks.en:
Greater reasoning capacity does not guarantee greater robustness.
Instead, stronger models can exhibit richer reasoning dynamics while becoming more vulnerable to hallucinated context, revealing a strong-model trap .
blocks.zh:
更大的推理能力并不能保证更强的稳健性。
相反,更强大的模型可以表现出更丰富的推理动力,同时更容易受到幻觉背景的影响,揭示出一个强大的模型陷阱。

blocks.en: 5.2 How Do Models Resolve Hallucinated Premises?
blocks.zh: 5.2 模型如何解决令人幻灭的房舍?

blocks.en:
To understand how models resolve hallucinated premises, we analyze their responses from three complementary perspectives.
First, we identify models’ behavioral resolution and insightful trajectories and then characterize their patterns.
Second, we examine the reasoning dynamics associated with different resolution behaviors and insightful trajectories.
Finally, we complement these aggregate analyses with qualitative cases to illustrate how behavioral resolution unfolds during reasoning.
blocks.zh:
为了了解模型如何解决幻觉的前提,我们从三个互补的角度分析它们的反应.
首先,我们确定模型的行为分辨率和具有洞察力的轨迹,然后描述它们的规律。
第二,我们审查与不同分辨率行为和有洞察力的轨迹有关的推理动态。
最后,我们用定性案例来补充这些综合分析,以说明行为分辨率如何在推理过程中发生。

blocks.en:
We categorize each reasoning trajectory into three behavioral modes according to how the model handles the hallucinated premise: Hallucination Compliance , where the model accepts the premise; Hallucination Avoidance , where the model bypasses the premise; and Heuristic Correction , where the model identifies and corrects the premise.
This categorization is independent of final-answer correctness.
To further capture successful post-hallucination reasoning, we define an insightful trajectory as one that performs heuristic correction and ultimately reaches the correct answer.
Detailed definitions and examples are provided in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们根据模型如何处理被幻觉的前提,将每个推理轨迹分为三种行为模式: 幻觉遵守 ,模型接受前提; 幻觉避免 ,模型绕过前提; 和 Heuristic 校正 ,模型识别并纠正了前提.
这种分类独立于最后答案正确性。
为了进一步捕捉在吸光后的成功推理,我们把有洞察力的轨迹定义为进行高压修正并最终找到正确答案的轨迹。
详细定义和实例见附录D.1。

blocks.en:
Most models predominantly comply with or avoid hallucinated premises rather than explicitly correcting them.
As shown in Table 2 , heuristic correction remains relatively infrequent across the 18 models, but increases consistently with model scale.
For example, scaling Qwen2.5 from 1.5 1.5 B to 72 72 B increases heuristic correction by 18.90 % ↑ 18.90\%\uparrow , with similar scaling trends observed for Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 .
According to Figure 4 , insightful trajectories follow the same overall trend but remain less frequent: 11 11 of 18 18 models produce them in fewer than 10 % 10\% of responses, while Qwen3-235B-A22B achieves the highest rate at 24.91 % 24.91\% .
The persistent gap between heuristic correction and insightful trajectories indicates that revising a hallucinated semantic does not necessarily lead to a correct final answer.
blocks.zh:
大多数模型主要遵守或避免了幻觉的前提,而不是明确纠正.
如表2所示,在18个模型中,高压校正仍然相对较少,但与模型尺度一致地增加。
例如,将Quen2.5从1.5 B 缩放到72 72 B 将热度校正增加18.90% QQ 18.90 oparrow ,在Quen3和Llama-3.1中观察到类似的缩放趋势。
根据图4,有洞察力的轨迹也遵循同一总体趋势,但频率仍然较低:18个模型中有11个给出了不到10%的10%的答复,而Qune3-235B-A22B达到24.91%24.91%的最高比率。
恒温修正和有洞察力的轨迹之间的持续差距表明,修订幻觉语义不一定导致正确的最终答案.

Different resolution behaviors exhibit distinct reasoning patterns of distributional change under the reference scorer.
As shown in Figure 5 , heuristic correction produces, on average, about 30 30 more reasoning words and a 0.31 0.31 higher BUF than hallucination compliance across the four representative models. Hallucination avoidance instead exhibits the highest average branching complexity.
More importantly, insightful trajectories achieve an average BUF of 0.63 0.63 , compared with only 0.18 0.18 for non-insightful trajectories.
These results suggest that successful resolution is associated with more frequent distributional shifts and longer reasoning trajectories.
Full details are provided in Appendix D.2 .

blocks.en:
Qualitative cases show that relevant knowledge alone is insufficient for resolving hallucinated premises.
As shown in Figure 6 , non-insightful trajectories may access the correct knowledge but ultimately allow the injected premise to override it.
Insightful trajectories instead reject the conflicting premise and redirect subsequent reasoning toward the correct answer.
This contrast supports effective belief updating as the key distinction of successful resolution.
More cases are provided in Appendix D.3 .
blocks.zh:
定性案例表明,仅靠相关知识不足以解决幻觉场所问题。
如图6所显示的,非视觉轨迹可能获取正确的知识,但最终允许被注入的前提被覆盖.
洞察力的轨迹相反地否定了相互冲突的前提,并将随后的推理转向正确的答案.
这种对比支持有效更新信念,作为成功解决的关键区别。
附录D.3提供了更多案例。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Qualitative comparison of insightful and non-insightful trajectories.
blocks.zh: 图6:洞察力和非洞察力轨迹的质量比较。

blocks.en:
Scaling increases models’ tendency to correct hallucinated premises, but correction alone is insufficient.
Insightful resolution depends on whether detected conflicts trigger effective belief revision that redirects subsequent reasoning.
blocks.zh:
缩放会增加模型纠正幻觉场所的倾向,但光是修正是不够的。
洞察解想取决于所发现的冲突是否触发了有效的信念修正,从而重新引导后继推理.

blocks.en: 5.3 Can We Predict Insightful Trajectories?
blocks.zh: 5.3 我们能否预测出难以想象的轨迹?

blocks.en:
Section 5.2 shows that insightful trajectories are relatively rare but exhibit distinctive reasoning dynamics.
In this section, we further examine whether their occurrence can be anticipated from properties of the input prompt before generation.
Specifically, we characterize prompts using structural and semantic features, evaluate their predictive power, and analyze the features and interactions that contribute to the prediction.
Full details are provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
第5.2节显示,具有洞察力的轨迹相对较少,但表现出独特的推理动力。
在本节中,我们进一步审查是否能够从生成前的输入的特性来预测其发生。
具体地说,我们用结构和语义特征来描述提示,评估它们的预测力,并分析有助于预测的特征和相互作用。
详情见附录E。

blocks.en: We construct 24 features to characterize factors that may trigger an insightful trajectory, covering both prompt structure and hallucination–task semantics. Representative features include Total Prompt Length , Candidate Count , Domain-Rule Violation , Error Locality , and Applicability Mismatch . Full definitions are provided in Appendix E.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们构建了24个特征来描述可能触发有洞察力的轨迹的因素,包括即时结构和幻觉任务语义。 代表特征包括:总快速长度、候选人数、域规则违规、错误位置和适用性错配。 完整的定义载于附录E.1。

blocks.en:
Prompt characteristics contain substantial predictive signal for whether an insightful trajectory will emerge.
We extract the 24 features for each hallucinated prompt using an external LLM ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ) and train an XGBRegressor ( Chen and Guestrin, 2016 ) to estimate its propensity to induce insightful reasoning.
The resulting predictor achieves an AUROC of 0.847 0.847 and an accuracy of 0.863 0.863 , indicating that the occurrence of insightful reasoning is systematically associated with properties available before generation rather than being entirely incidental.
blocks.zh:
即时特性包含是否将出现有见地的轨迹的实质性预测信号。
我们利用外部LLM(郑等,2023;李等,2025)提取出每个幻觉快感的24个特征,并训练出XGB回放器(陈等,2016)来估计其诱导有见地推理的倾向.
由此得出的预测器的AUROC为0.847 0.847,精确度为0.863 0.863,表明有见地推理的发生与世代之前已有的属性有系统联系,而不是完全偶然的.

blocks.en:
The predictive signal is distributed across both structural and semantic properties of the prompt.
As shown in Figure 7(a) , Total Prompt Length is the strongest individual predictor, accounting for 20.7 % 20.7\% of the global SHAP contribution ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ; Lundberg et al., 2020 ) , substantially exceeding other structural features.
Hallucinated augmentation-specific semantics also contribute substantially, with Domain-Rule Violation and Error Locality accounting for 7.4 % 7.4\% and 7.2 % 7.2\% , respectively.
blocks.zh:
预测信号分布在快报的结构特性和语义特性上.
如图7(a)所示,总快速长度是个人最强的预测器,占全球SHAP贡献的20.7%和20.7%(Lundberg和Lee,2017;Lundberg等,2020年),大大超过其他结构特征。
迷幻增强特定语义也做出了很大贡献,域规则违规和出错位置分别占7.4% 7.4% 7.2% 7.2% 7.2% .

blocks.en:
This predictive structure is not dominated by strong pairwise interactions.
As shown in Figure 7(b) , the largest interaction occurs between Total Prompt Length and Question Length ( 0.020 0.020 ), while nearly all remaining pairwise interactions are below 0.01 0.01 .
Together with their non-trivial individual contributions, these weak interactions suggest that the selected features decouple and capture largely complementary aspects of the conditions associated with insightful reasoning.
blocks.zh:
这种预测结构并非由强双相相互作用所主导.
如图7(b)所示,最大规模的相互作用发生在 " 全速长度 " 和 " 问题长度 " (0.020.0.020)之间,而几乎所有剩余的对偶相互作用都低于0.010.01。
这些薄弱的相互作用加上他们个人的非三角性贡献,表明所选定的特征脱钩,并在很大程度上捕捉到与有洞察力的推理相关条件的互补方面。

blocks.en:
Insightful reasoning is predictable before generation.
Its emergence reflects complementary structural and hallucination–task semantic properties of the prompt as dominant factors.
blocks.zh:
洞察推理在一代人之前是可以预测的.
它的出现反映了互补的结构与幻觉 — 即作为主导因素的即时语义特性。

blocks.zh: (a) 最有影响力的速成特征的全球自助方案的贡献和方向效应。

blocks.en: (b) Pairwise SHAP interaction effects among the most influential prompt-level features.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce PHRBench , a comprehensive benchmark for behaviorally structured post-hallucination reasoning across four domains and 18 18 LLMs. With the evaluation results, our analysis shows that hallucinated context consistently degrades performance, while larger models simultaneously exhibit stronger corrective behavior, revealing a tension between vulnerability and recovery capability. By separating hallucination compliance , hallucination avoidance , and heuristic correction from final outcomes, we further show that successful correction remains relatively rare and is characterized by stronger belief updating.
We also find that successful correction can be anticipated from properties of the hallucinated semantics before generation. A lightweight predictor based on structural and semantic features achieves strong predictive performance, with factors such as domain-rule violation and error locality contributing substantially. Together, these results suggest that reliable PHR requires evaluating not only whether a model reaches the correct answer, but also how it resolves hallucinated context and when successful recovery is likely to occur.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了PHR Bench, 这是针对四个领域和18个LLMs的行为结构化后推理的综合基准。 有了评价结果,我们的分析表明,幻觉环境不断降低性能,而较大的模型同时显示出更强的纠正行为,揭示出脆弱性与恢复能力之间的紧张关系。 通过将幻觉遵守性、避免幻觉和精神矫正与最终结果区分开来,我们进一步表明,成功的矫正仍然相对罕见,其特点是加强信念更新。
我们还发现,从产生幻觉的语义的特性中可以预期到在一代之前就能够成功校正. 基于结构和语义特征的轻量级预测器能实现强烈的预测性能,如域规则被违反和出错地点等因素会造成重大影响. 这些结果表明,可靠的医生促进人权方案不仅要求评估一个模型是否达到正确的答案,而且要求评估它如何解决幻觉环境以及何时有可能成功恢复。

blocks.en: A.1 Data Collection and Statistics
blocks.zh: A.1 数据收集和统计

blocks.en: We construct PHRBench by collecting 460 460 base questions from eight established benchmarks across four domains: Chemistry, Biomedicine, Physics, and Code Generation. We retain questions that require domain-specific or computational reasoning and organize the collected instances by domain as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们从化学、生物医学、物理和密码生成这四个领域的8个既定基准中收集了460,460个基础问题。 我们保留需要特定领域或计算推理的问题,并按领域组织收集实例如下。

blocks.en:
Chemistry. Chemistry reasoning requires models to infer molecular properties and apply established chemical principles and mechanisms.
We collect 50 50 molecular-property questions from MoleculeNet-BBBP, 50 50 chemistry reasoning questions from ChemBench, and 20 20 open-ended chemistry questions from GPQA, yielding 120 120 questions in total.
blocks.zh:
化学 化学推理需要模型来推断分子性质并应用已确立的化学原理和机制.
我们从MoleculeNet-BBBP收集了50个分子财产问题,从Chem Bench收集了50个化学推理问题,从GPQA收集了20个开放式化学问题,总共产生了120个120个问题.

blocks.en:
Biomedicine. Biomedical reasoning requires models to integrate medical and biological knowledge with task-specific conditions to derive diagnoses, mechanisms, or conclusions.
We select 100 100 questions from MedMCQA and 20 20 open-ended biology questions from GPQA, resulting in 120 120 questions.
blocks.zh:
生物医学. 生物医学推理需要模型将医学和生物学知识与特定任务条件相融合,以得出诊断,机制,或结论.
我们从MedMCQA中选择了100个问题,从GPQA中选择了20个开放式的生物学问题,结果产生了120个120个问题.

blocks.en:
Physics. Physics reasoning requires models to apply established physical laws, conceptual relations, and quantitative constraints.
We collect 14 14 questions from MMLU College Physics, 36 36 from MMLU Conceptual Physics, 50 50 from SciQ, and 20 20 open-ended physics questions from GPQA, yielding 120 120 questions.
blocks.zh:
物理学。 物理推理需要模型应用既定的物理定律,概念关系,以及数量限制.
我们收集了来自MMLU学院物理的14个问题,来自MMLU概念物理的36个问题,来自SciQ的50个问题,以及来自GPQA的20个开放式物理问题,产生了120个120个问题.

blocks.en:
Code Generation. Code generation requires models to interpret semantic specifications, compose procedural logic, and produce executable solutions.
We select 50 50 problems from HumanEval and 50 50 from MBPP, resulting in 100 100 coding problems.
blocks.zh:
代号生成. 代码生成需要模型来解释语义规范,作曲程序逻辑,并产生可执行的解决方案.
我们从HumanEval中选择了50个问题,从MBPP中选择了50个问题,导致100个100个编码问题.

blocks.en:
After integrating questions from the eight source benchmarks, we further categorize all 460 460 instances according to their primary reasoning requirements.
The taxonomy follows a hierarchical structure of Domain → \rightarrow Reasoning Subtype .
When a source benchmark provides an appropriate native task or subdomain label, we retain that label whenever possible; otherwise, questions are harmonized into a unified domain-specific taxonomy.
Importantly, the assigned subtype reflects the primary reasoning process required to solve the question rather than the benchmark from which it originates.
This provides a unified characterization of reasoning requirements across heterogeneous source datasets.
blocks.zh:
在综合了来自8个来源基准的问题之后,我们进一步按照主要推理要求,对所有460,460个案例进行了分类。
分类学遵循域_\正弦理性子类型的分级结构.
当一个源基准提供了适当的本地任务或子域标签时,我们尽可能保留该标签;否则,问题统一为一个统一的域特有分类法.
重要的是,分配的子类型反映了解决问题所需的主要推理过程,而不是其来源的基准。
这为各种源数据集的推理要求提供了统一的定性。

blocks.en:
Table 3 reports the resulting reasoning-category distribution.
For reasoning-category annotation, we first preserve native task or subdomain labels when they are compatible with our taxonomy. Questions without suitable native labels are manually mapped to the domain-specific reasoning subtypes according to their primary reasoning requirement. Each question is assigned to a single subtype to ensure a mutually exclusive partition of the 460 460 base questions.
The resulting taxonomy captures substantial within-domain variation in reasoning requirements and enables subsequent analysis to distinguish effects associated with domain from those associated with specific reasoning patterns.
blocks.zh:
表3报告了由此产生的推理类分布。
对于推理类注释,我们首先保留本地任务或子域标签,当它们与我们的分类学兼容时. 没有合适的本土标签的问题,按照主要推理要求,人工地被映射到特定域推理子类型. 每个问题被分配到一个单一的子类型,以确保460,460个基础问题的相互排斥分出.
由此产生的分类法捕捉到域内推理要求的巨大差异,并使得后期分析能够区分与域相关效应和与特定推理模式相关效应.

blocks.zh: 表3:PHR Bench中460个基础问题的子类型分布原因 百分比在每个领域内计算。

blocks.en: A.2 Augmentation Construction
blocks.zh: A.2 扩建工程

blocks.en: Before augmentation, we standardize questions from different source benchmarks using task-specific templates while preserving the original task semantics, answer space, and evaluation criteria. For each base question, we construct three standardized input forms: the original question ( B ), the question paired with a truthful augmentation ( B+T ), and the question paired with a hallucinated augmentation ( B+H ). The augmentation is inserted as additional contextual information without modifying the underlying question or explicitly revealing the target answer. All standardized instances are converted into English and follow a consistent input structure within each task type, enabling controlled comparison across the baseline, truthful, and hallucinated augmentation settings.
blocks.zh: 在增强之前,我们使用特定任务模板,将不同源基准的问题标准化,同时保留原有的任务语义,解答空间和评价标准. 对于每个基础问题,我们构建出三个标准化的输入表:原始问题(B),问题与真实的加成对(B+T),问题与幻觉加成对(B+H). 增加部分作为额外的背景信息被插入,而没有修改基本的问题或明确披露目标答案。 所有标准化实例均被转换为英文,并遵循每个任务类型中一致的输入结构,从而能够在基线、真实性和幻觉增强设置上进行有控制的比较。

blocks.en: We categorize hallucinated augmentations into three types according to the nature of the injected semantic error.
blocks.zh: 我们根据所注入语义错误的性质,将幻觉增强分为三种.

blocks.en: Rule Contradiction introduces a premise that directly conflicts with an established rule, principle, or domain fact. Its falsity is independent of the specific problem instance, and identifying the error primarily requires retrieving and maintaining the relevant domain knowledge.
blocks.zh: 规则相悖性引入了一个与既定规则、原则或领域事实直接相冲突的前提。 它的伪造独立于特定的问题实例,识别出错误主要需要检索和维护相关的域名知识.

blocks.en: State Distortion introduces a statement that may be valid in general but is incorrect under the specific conditions of the current problem. Detecting such an error therefore requires instance-level verification of the relevant properties, conditions, intermediate states, or computational logic rather than relying solely on general knowledge.
blocks.zh: 国家扭曲引入了一种声明,该声明总体上可能有效,但在目前问题的具体条件下是不正确的。 因此,要检测这种错误,就需要对有关属性、条件、中间状态或计算逻辑进行实例一级的核查,而不是仅仅依靠一般知识。

blocks.en: Pseudoscientific Entanglement introduces an outdated, discredited, or pseudoscientific theory as a premise for reasoning. This type evaluates whether the model can maintain consistency with established scientific knowledge when confronted with an apparently explanatory but invalid theoretical account.
blocks.zh: 修道会 缠绕引入了过时的,无信誉的,或伪科学理论作为推理的前提. 这种类型的评价是在面对显然解释性但无效的理论陈述时,该模型能否与既定科学知识保持一致。

blocks.en: Together, these augmentation types create semantic conflicts at different levels, ranging from violations of established knowledge to instance-specific mismatches and invalid explanatory frameworks.
blocks.zh: 这些增强类型加在一起在不同层面造成语义冲突,从侵犯既定知识到具体实例的不匹配和无效的解释性框架等。

blocks.en:
We use GPT-4o as the generator to construct augmentations for each standardized base question. Given the original task, the generator produces one truthful augmentation and multiple hallucinated augmentations that are directly relevant to the question. The truthful augmentation provides factually valid supplementary information, whereas each hallucinated augmentation introduces a targeted semantic error without explicitly revealing the answer.
Specifically, for each question in Chemistry, Biomedicine, and Physics, we construct one truthful augmentation and 10 10 hallucinated augmentations, whereas each Code Generation problem is paired with one truthful augmentation and 3 3 hallucinated augmentations. This results in 460 460 truthful augmentations and 3900 3900 hallucinated augmentations in total. The domain-wise distribution of the three hallucinated augmentation types is shown in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh:
我们用GPT-4o作为发电机,为每一个标准化的基础问题建造增强装置。 鉴于最初的任务,发电机产生一种与问题直接相关的真实增强和多种幻觉增强. 真实的增强提供了事实上有效的补充信息,而每次幻觉的增强都引入了有针对性的语义错误而没有明确揭示答案.
具体地说,对于化学,生物医学和物理学中的每一个问题, 我们构建了一个真实的增强和10个幻觉的增强, 而每一个代码生成问题 都配有一个真实的增强和3个幻觉的增强。 这导致460,460次真实的增强和3,900次幻觉的增强。 图2显示三种幻觉增强型的域位分布。

blocks.en: To encourage semantic diversity, hallucinated augmentations associated with the same base question are required to differ in their underlying error rather than merely rephrasing the same incorrect claim. Depending on the task, the generator constructs hallucinated augmentations using the three augmentation types described above, with particular emphasis on creating both direct rule conflicts and instance-specific state distortions.
blocks.zh: 为了鼓励语义多样性,与同一基本问题有关的幻觉增强必须在其基本错误上有所不同,而不只是重写同样的错误主张。 发电机根据任务的不同,利用上述三种增强类型制造出幻觉增强,并特别强调造成直接规则冲突和具体实例的状态扭曲。

blocks.en: For traceability, each hallucinated augmentation is generated together with a mutation strategy , which records its augmentation type, and a mutation logic , which explicitly describes the injected error. Each truthful augmentation is accompanied by a truth verification field specifying why the added information is valid. The resulting augmentations are subsequently assembled with the standardized base questions to form the B+T and B+H evaluation instances.
blocks.zh: 对于可追溯性,每次幻觉增强都会与一个能记录其增强类型的突变策略相伴而生,还有一个能明确描述被注入出错的突变逻辑. 每一次真实的增加都附有一个核实真相的领域,具体说明所增加的信息为何有效。 由此产生的扩增随后与标准化的基础问题合并,形成B+T和B+H评价实例。

blocks.en: We apply a multi-stage quality-control procedure to ensure that the constructed augmentations are semantically valid, task-relevant, and consistent with their intended mutation types.
blocks.zh: 我们采用多阶段质量控制程序,确保所建造的扩能装置具有充分的有效性、任务相关性并符合其预期的突变类型。

blocks.en:
First, we impose explicit constraints during generation.
Each hallucinated augmentation is required to introduce a single targeted semantic mutation , while preserving the original question and the remaining contextual information.
Hallucinated augmentations associated with the same base question must correspond to different erroneous claims or affected properties rather than surface-level paraphrases of the same error.
Truthful augmentations are required to be factually correct, relevant to the corresponding task, and free from the errors introduced by the hallucinated augmentations.
Neither truthful nor hallucinated augmentations are allowed to explicitly reveal the target answer.
blocks.zh:
第一,我们在一代人时期施加了明确的限制。
每个幻觉增强需要引入一个单一的目标语义突变,同时保留原始问题和所剩的上下文信息.
与同一基本问题有关的幻觉增强必须对应不同的错误索赔或受影响的属性,而不是同一错误的表层解释。
真实的增强需要事实正确,与相应任务相关,并避免幻觉增强带来的错误.
无论是真实的还是幻觉的增强都不能明确揭示目标答案。

blocks.en:
Second, we manually review all generated augmentations, including both truthful and hallucinated augmentations, to assess their suitability for the corresponding base question.
For truthful augmentations, we check that the added information is factually correct, relevant to the question, and applicable under the conditions of the original task.
For hallucinated augmentations, we check that the added information is relevant to the question but contains the intended semantic error, is consistent with the assigned augmentation type, and introduces only one dominant erroneous premise.
We also remove or revise augmentations that are ambiguous, redundant with other augmentations of the same question, insufficiently related to the task, or likely to leak the answer.
blocks.zh:
第二,我们手动审查所有产生的扩增,包括真实的和有幻觉的扩增,以评估它们是否适合相应的基础问题。
为了进行真实的扩充,我们核实所增加的信息事实上是正确的,与问题有关,并在最初任务的条件下适用。
对于幻觉增强,我们检查所添加的信息是否与问题相关,但包含意向语义错误,与指定增强类型一致,仅引入一个主导性错误前提.
我们还删除或修订含糊不清、与同一问题的其他扩大相重复、与任务关系不足或可能泄露答案的扩大。

blocks.en:
Third, we perform an additional LLM-as-a-judge verification using Gemini 3 Pro.
For each candidate augmentation, the judge re-evaluates its factual validity, relevance to the base question, and consistency with the assigned mutation type.
For hallucinated augmentations, the judge further checks whether the stated mutation logic correctly identifies the underlying semantic error; for truthful augmentations, it verifies that the added information remains factually valid and does not conflict with the original task.
This second-pass verification serves as an independent consistency check after manual review.
blocks.zh:
第三,我们用双子座3 Pro 进行额外的 LLM as- a judge 验证.
对于每个候选人,法官重新评价其事实有效性、与基准问题的相关性以及与指定变异类型的一致性。
对于有幻觉的增强,法官进一步检查所陈述的突变逻辑是否正确识别了基本的语义错误;对于真实的增强,法官进一步核实所添加的信息在事实上仍然有效,与原任务并不相冲突.
这一二次通过核查是经过人工审查后的独立一致性检查。

blocks.en:
Only augmentations that satisfy the generation constraints and pass both manual review and the subsequent LLM-based verification are retained in the final benchmark.
This layered procedure reduces annotation noise and helps ensure that the observed model behavior can be attributed to the intended semantic perturbation rather than artifacts introduced during augmentation construction.
blocks.zh:
在最后基准中只保留满足生成限制和通过人工审查和随后基于LLM的核查的增强。
这种分层程序会减少注释噪声,并有助于确保所观察到的模型行为可以被归结为意向语义扰动,而不是增强构造过程中引入的文物.

blocks.en: We use separate prompts for the two augmentation types, and each generation call produces exactly one augmentation so that truthful controls and individual semantic mutations are constructed independently.

blocks.en:
We evaluate each generated response from two complementary perspectives:
final-answer correctness and reasoning-trajectory characteristics. Accuracy
measures whether the model ultimately reaches the correct answer, whereas
Output Length (OL), Uncertainty Index (UI), Belief Update Frequency (BUF),
and Branching Complexity (BC) characterize different properties of the
generated reasoning trajectory. To ensure comparability between proprietary
and open-source models, probability-based trajectory metrics are computed
post hoc using a fixed reference language model, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. The
same reference scorer and metric configuration are used for all models,
domains, and experimental conditions.

blocks.en:
Tables 5 – 8 report detailed results for Chemistry, Biomedicine, Physics, and
Code Generation, respectively, allowing us to examine how the effects
of hallucinated context vary across domains.

blocks.en:
The decrease in final-answer accuracy is broadly consistent across domains.
Averaged over the 18 18 evaluated models, the accuracy drop is 6.57 6.57 percentage points in Chemistry, 8.34 8.34 points in Biomedicine, 7.12 7.12 points in Physics, and 6.89 6.89 points in Code Generation. All models degrade under hallucinated augmentation in the three scientific domains, while 17 17 of 18 18 models degrade in Code Generation, with Qwen3-8B showing only a marginal 0.1 0.1 -point increase. Thus, the overall performance degradation reported in the main text is not driven by a single domain. Biomedicine exhibits the largest average degradation, followed by Physics, whereas Chemistry shows the smallest absolute drop. Notably, Chemistry also has substantially lower baseline accuracy on average ( 23.0 % 23.0\% ) than Biomedicine ( 57.2 % 57.2\% ), Physics ( 56.0 % 56.0\% ), and Code Generation ( 48.4 % 48.4\% ), suggesting that its smaller absolute degradation should not be interpreted as greater robustness, since the available performance margin is considerably smaller.

scientific and computational reasoning settings.

Across the 18 18 models, SD causes the largest average accuracy drop ( 9.4 9.4 percentage points), followed by RC ( 7.4 7.4 points), whereas PE has a substantially weaker effect ( 1.8 1.8 points). This pattern suggests that instance-specific misinformation is particularly difficult to resolve: unlike direct violations of established rules, SD preserves a plausible general statement while making it inconsistent with the conditions of the

The trajectory metrics reveal a less uniform pattern than final-answer accuracy. SD is associated with both longer responses and increased branching complexity on average, suggesting greater exploration of competing reasoning paths under instance-level conflict. RC produces a smaller increase in output length and lower branching complexity, while PE often elicits longer
responses without a commensurate loss in accuracy. Together, these results show that the effect of hallucinated context depends not only on whether the information is false, but also on the form of semantic conflict it introduces.

already present in the reasoning context. Our taxonomy is response-level and

A response is classified as Hallucination Compliance when the
hallucinated premise remains active in the model’s reasoning and is treated
as valid information. Compliance requires more than simply repeating the
premise: the response must rely on it to constrain, justify, or redirect the
reasoning trajectory. A model may acknowledge that the premise differs from
its prior knowledge yet still be classified as compliant if it ultimately
accepts the injected premise (e.g., “assuming the premise is true”) and
bases its conclusion on it. Importantly, compliance does not imply that the
final answer must be incorrect; the model may occasionally reach the correct
answer despite reasoning from the hallucinated augmentation.

simply ignores the premise, even if it produces the correct answer, provides
no evidence that the model recognized the premise as false.

blocks.en: D.2 Reasoning Dynamics Analysis

blocks.en:
The main text illustrates reasoning-dynamics patterns using four representative models (Claude-Sonnet-4, GPT-4o, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) for clarity of presentation.
Here, we extend the analysis to all 18 18 evaluated models and report the complete trajectory statistics under Hallucination Compliance, Hallucination Avoidance, and Heuristic Correction.
Specifically, we examine Output Length (OL), Uncertainty Index (UI), Belief Update Frequency (BUF), and Branching Complexity (BC), providing a comprehensive view of how different resolution behaviors are associated with reasoning dynamics across the full model set.

在这里,我们把分析扩大到所有18个被评价的模型,并报告在 " 迷幻守法 " 、 " 迷幻避险 " 和 " 休克 " 下的全部轨迹统计。
具体来说,我们审查了产出长度(OL)、不确定性指数(UI)、信仰更新频率(BUF)和分支复杂度(BC),全面介绍了不同分辨率行为如何与整个模型集的推理动态相关联。

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
The full-model results broadly confirm the patterns observed in the four representative models. Across the evaluated models, Heuristic Correction is associated with longer reasoning trajectories and higher BUF than Compliance or Avoidance, indicating that explicit correction typically involves more
extensive reasoning and stronger belief revision.
In contrast, Hallucination Avoidance generally exhibits higher BC, suggesting greater exploration of alternative reasoning paths without directly revising the hallucinated augmentation.
UI shows no consistent ordering across the three behaviors, indicating that predictive uncertainty is less directly tied to the mode of hallucination resolution.
Overall, the clearest distinction is between branching and belief revision: avoidance tends to broaden the reasoning process, whereas correction is characterized by more substantial belief updating.

blocks.en: D.3 Qualitative Analysis

blocks.en: We provide additional qualitative cases to illustrate how successful and unsuccessful resolution processes unfold beyond the representative examples used to define the behavioral categories in Appendix D.1 .

blocks.en:
For each pair, we hold the model and base question fixed while varying the hallucinated augmentation.
Across these cases, the critical distinction is not whether the model can retrieve the relevant knowledge, since both trajectory types often identify the correct rule before reaching the final answer.
Rather, successful resolution depends on whether the detected conflict produces a persistent revision of the reasoning state.
Non-insightful trajectories locally recognize the inconsistency but later restore the hallucinated premise as a constraint, whereas insightful trajectories retain the corrected belief and use it to guide the remaining reasoning.

对每对来说,我们把模型和基础问题固定下来,同时改变幻觉的增强.

相反,成功解决取决于所发现的冲突是否导致持续地修改推理状态。
非视觉轨迹当地承认不一致,但后来恢复了幻觉的前提作为制约,而有洞察力的轨迹则保留了被修正的信念并用它来指导剩下的推理.
